g1.label: 1 — First Nations ___ it for hundreds of years
g1.why: The text says First Nations played lacrosse for hundreds of years before Europeans arrived.

g2.label: 2 — who ___ the game in 1891
g2.why: The text says James Naismith invented basketball in 1891.

g3.label: 3 — head to the ___ to ski
g3.why: The text says families head to the mountains to ski or snowboard.

g4.label: 4 — the frozen ___ Canal
g4.why: The text names the frozen Rideau Canal in Ottawa.

g5.label: 5 — hike, camp and ___
g5.why: The text lists hiking, camping and canoeing as summer activities.

g6.label: 6 — forests turn ___ and gold
g6.why: The text says the forests turn red and gold in autumn.

g7.label: 7 — visitors are always ___
g7.why: The closing paragraph says visitors are always welcome to join in.

g8.label: 8 — you will ___ both of them
g8.why: The final line says you will need both your skates and your sense of adventure.

g1.label: 1 — millions of Canadians ___ ice hockey
g1.why: A repeated habit ('every winter') takes the present simple.

g2.label: 2 — the children ___ right now
g2.why: 'Right now' signals an action in progress — present continuous.

g3.label: 3 — Lacrosse ___ from an Indigenous game
g3.why: A general fact about the sport's origin — present simple.

g4.label: 4 — the workers ___ the rink now
g4.why: 'Right now' — the action is happening at this moment: present continuous.

g5.label: 5 — Water ___ at 0°C
g5.why: A scientific fact that is always true — present simple.

g6.label: 6 — my partner ___ for a marathon
g6.why: 'At the moment' marks a temporary action in progress.

g7.label: 7 — fans ___ the NHL every Saturday
g7.why: A regular routine ('every Saturday night') — present simple.

g8.label: 8 — the final ___ right now
g8.why: Something beginning at this moment — present continuous.

g1.label: 1 — my friend ___ all the players
g1.why: Know is a stative verb (a state of mind) — no continuous form here.

g2.label: 2 — these skates ___ to my sister
g2.why: Belong describes a state, not an action — present simple.

g3.label: 3 — I ___ what you mean
g3.why: Understand is stative — use the present simple.

g4.label: 4 — we ___ to watch the final
g4.why: Want is a stative verb — no continuous form.

g5.label: 5 — since the 1990s, Canada ___ wilderness (review)
g5.why: Review from 'Discover Canada — The Environment': 'since the 1990s' up to now needs the present perfect.

g6.label: 6 — do you ___ why Canadians love the cold?
g6.why: After 'do you', the verb stays in the base form: know.

g7.label: 7 — ice hockey ___ in every province (review)
g7.why: Review from 'Inside India': the game receives the action — passive: is + past participle.

g8.label: 8 — this cabin ___ like a second home
g8.why: Feel meaning 'gives the impression' is stative — present simple.
